objective: Finish the current S1-mini work from the real baseline at commit 37edaf2 plus the preserved in-progress T4 working-tree changes: make incremental cleanup session-safe and lossless, benchmark and integrate the fastest bounded Metal scheduler on the target M1, expose truthful lifecycle state, and prove quality and long-session latency before release.
end_state: Committed T1-T3 behavior remains intact. Streaming English dictation cleans stable source spans during recording without ever blocking ASR, final ASR revisions reconcile by exact source offsets, the measured Metal scheduler has bounded concurrency and hard deadlines, the overlay and Journal reflect real applied or degraded state, and the complete production path passes quality, latency, memory, cancellation, failure, and 30-minute soak gates on the M1 8 GB machine.
non_goals: Do not reimplement or rewrite committed T1, T2, or T3 unless a remaining-task regression test proves a defect.
Do not discard, reset, stash, or overwrite the existing uncommitted T4 work in actions.rs, managers/transcription.rs, local_cleanup/mod.rs, audio_feedback.rs, or escape_cancel.rs.
Do not promise rich Markdown headings, bold, links, summaries, or arbitrary instruction following; S1-mini supports clean prose and conservative lists.
Do not send catalog JSON to S1-mini, add unbounded concurrency, duplicate model weights, or add a cleanup accelerator dropdown.
Do not redesign the Journal or recording overlay, persist cleanup provenance in history, or modify the optional cloud AI cleanup feature.
Do not commit or redistribute the GGUF runtime asset.

T2 at 4b15b3a: raw ASR reaches S1, ambiguous bare programming aliases are denied or evidence-gated, and technical vocabulary normalization moved after cleanup.

tasks.title: Finish the in-progress incremental cleanup session safely
tasks.description: Audit and evolve the existing dirty T4 implementation rather than replacing it. Move session ownership out of the now-1,488-line local_cleanup/mod.rs, add a session generation ID and effective language, make committed publication non-blocking through a coalescing latest-snapshot mailbox, schedule stable token spans without depending on punctuation, cancel stale work, and reconcile final ASR by exact source offsets and longest common prefix.
building_blocks: Existing start_session, submit_committed, finalize_session, SpanSlot, SessionInner, and seal_boundary code
NonBlockingCommitBridge with latest snapshot, scheduled byte cursor, try_send wake, and overload state
Token-aware StableSegmentAssembler with exact source byte spans and 40/60/80-token candidate tails
packages: existing std, tokio, transcribe-cpp, and llama-cpp-2 only

files.what: Preserve install, status, prompt, validation, engine, and T1-T3 behavior; move T4 session logic behind a focused child module.
Own session IDs, non-blocking ingress, source spans, token-tail sealing, overload, cancellation, and final reconciliation.
Publish committed snapshots without blocking stream.feed and finalize or cancel the exact cleanup session.
Start one language-aware session per recording and consume its CleanupResult, retaining whole-text cleanup for batch-only paths.
Preserve the current working-tree changes and connect cancellation to the active cleanup session only where the real recording cancellation path requires it.

subtasks.description: Snapshot the current dirty diff, map every new T4 caller and state transition, and add characterization tests before refactoring; do not restore or overwrite user changes.

Replace process-global anonymous ACTIVE_SESSION with CleanupSessionId { generation: u64 } plus effective language; reject non-English incremental work and ignore late results whose generation is no longer active.

Implement publish_committed as a non-blocking operation on the ASR worker: update the latest monotonic snapshot under a short lock and try_send one wake; when full, coalesce later snapshots without losing the scheduled byte cursor.

On the cleanup side, own latest_snapshot[scheduled_cursor..] exactly once, prefer paragraph or sentence boundaries, but seal by tokenizer budget when raw committed ASR has no punctuation; leave a measured candidate tail of 40, 60, or 80 tokens provisional.

Represent every sealed slot as source Range<usize>, exact original source slice, boundary metadata, sequence number, and asynchronous CleanupResult; never reconstruct a prefix by trimming and joining strings.

At finalization compute the longest common prefix of committed snapshot and final_text, retain only completed spans ending before the divergence offset, invalidate every intersecting or later span, and reschedule final_text from the first invalidated source offset. If safe byte mapping fails, discard incremental results and run complete final-text cleanup.
Cancel queued and generating jobs for stop-abandon, Escape, model switch, failed stream, and superseded session; guarantee one terminal result and no stale paste or event.
Keep non-streaming and failed-streaming ASR on the production whole-text token-aware cleanup path and retain all committed T1-T3 acceptance tests.

tests.description: Saturate cleanup while continuously feeding ASR and prove publish_committed never blocks, later snapshots coalesce, and every source byte is eventually owned exactly once.
Replay punctuation-free committed text past multiple token caps and prove background spans seal while a provisional tail remains.

Test final divergence before the first span, inside an early sealed span, at a middle boundary, inside the provisional tail, and as total replacement; assert no duplicate, omitted, or reordered source.
Test non-English sessions, duplicate/stale revisions, cancellation during generation, rapid next recording, batch-only ASR, and failed streaming fallback.

acceptance_criteria: Existing T1-T3 behavior and tests remain green and the current dirty T4 work is evolved rather than overwritten.
Cleanup cannot block stream.feed; overload coalesces wake notifications while retaining the complete latest committed source.
Punctuation-free raw ASR still schedules token-bounded background work.
Only English sessions invoke S1 and every late result is scoped to the matching session generation.
Final divergence retains only exact source spans ending before the longest-common-prefix offset and safely reschedules every later byte.
Cancel, batch fallback, and failed-streaming paths terminate exactly once without stale text.

tasks.title: Benchmark concurrency, deadlines, and revision-tail constants on the M1
tasks.description: Use an ignored in-crate benchmark module so the experiment executes the private production prompt, tokenizer, T4 session path, validator, engine, and assembler. Compare serial, shared-model two-context, and llama.cpp multi-sequence candidates while Parakeet streams. Select concurrency and exact queue, generation, finish, and retained-tail constants from recorded distributions, not intuition.
building_blocks: llama.cpp n_seq_max and sequence-ID batching candidate
Warm p50, p95, and p99 distributions

files.what: Run production-private scheduling candidates and emit machine-readable measurements under cfg(test).
Register bench.rs only under cfg(test).
Record exact hardware, model hash, fixture hashes, commands, raw samples, distributions, rejected candidates, winner, and selected constants.
Remove the stale invalid-control benchmark after the production-faithful harness replaces it.

subtasks.description: Run with cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib local_cleanup::bench:: -- --ignored --nocapture and pin formal/lists/general, empty think block, greedy decode, production tokenizer, validator, session, and model hash.

Measure warm serial baseline and concurrency 2, 3, and 4 candidates over short, 2,584-character, 10-minute, and 30-minute traces with at least 10 repetitions for short/medium and three for long traces.

Run every candidate concurrently with Parakeet streaming and collect prompt-eval speed, generation speed, queue wait, per-chunk and stop-tail latency, aggregate throughput, ASR RTF, RSS, memory pressure, swap, and failures.

Select the smallest concurrency that improves aggregate cleanup throughput by at least 20 percent and stop-to-paste p95 by at least 15 percent, with no semantic-output change, swap, red memory pressure, or ASR RTF regression above 10 percent; otherwise select serial incremental execution.
Choose retained_tail_tokens as the smallest of 40, 60, or 80 with zero boundary-fidelity failures and normal stop backlog no larger than one chunk plus tail; if none passes, record no-go.

Derive queue_deadline = clamp(2 * warm p99 queue wait, 250 ms, 2 s), generation_deadline = clamp(1.5 * warm p99 maximum-chunk generation + 250 ms, 2 s, 8 s), and finish_deadline = clamp(2 * warm p99 stop-tail + 250 ms, 1.5 s, 5 s). Record exact values and overload evidence.

tests.description: Assert identical fixture hashes and greedy output semantics across candidates before comparing cost.
Repeat the winner after cold app start and after a 30-minute concurrent ASR/cleanup soak.

acceptance_criteria: benchmark-results.md contains reproducible commands, raw samples, p50/p95/p99 values, before/after table, and reasons every candidate was accepted or rejected.
Prompt evaluation and output generation throughput are reported separately.
The selected model/context strategy loads weights once, has a hard concurrency cap, causes no swap, and does not materially slow ASR.
Exact concurrency, retained_tail_tokens, queue_deadline, generation_deadline, and finish_deadline values are recorded for T6; T6 may not choose new values.

tasks.title: Integrate the measured Metal scheduler and hard deadlines
tasks.description: Implement only the T5 winner. Keep one Metal-loaded model independent of the speech accelerator dropdown, bound active contexts or sequences and queue capacity, prioritize final tails, enforce the recorded queue/generation/finish deadlines inside token decode, recover KV state after timeout, and deliver every session exactly once in source order.

files.what: Own the single Metal model, selected context or multi-sequence configuration, greedy decode, token-loop deadlines, and KV recovery.
Own bounded queues, priority, fairness, overload, cancellation, deadlines, and exactly-once result delivery.
Delegate the existing job loop to engine and scheduler modules while preserving install/status and committed T1-T4 contracts.

subtasks.description: Encode the exact T5 concurrency, retained tail, queue deadline, generation deadline, and finish deadline in one typed SchedulerConfig; reference the benchmark report and do not retune during implementation.
Initialize exactly one LlamaBackend and LlamaModel with 99 Metal layers regardless of transcribe_accelerator or transcribe_gpu_device.
Bound active work and queue capacity, coalesce commit notifications through T4 ingress, prioritize finish-tail work, and retain starvation-free background progress.
Check cancellation and generation_deadline at every decode token; on expiry remove the affected KV sequence or recreate the context and return a typed chunk-local timeout fallback.
Enforce queue_deadline before dispatch and finish_deadline at session orchestration; terminate every waiter once and ignore late cancelled, expired, or superseded completions.
On fatal engine failure set READY false, fail pending work once, emit cleanup-model-failed, and permit existing preload/install recovery.

tests.description: Stress queue saturation, priority, out-of-order completions, concurrent sessions, and cancellation without deadlock or source loss.
Exercise timeout before dispatch, timeout during decode, finish expiry, KV/context recovery, and a successful job immediately after each timeout.
Toggle speech CPU/Auto/GPU and verify S1 stays Metal with identical scheduler configuration.

acceptance_criteria: T6 consumes the exact T5 constants and strategy without introducing an unmeasured alternative.
One model allocation is shared and cleanup remains Metal-only independent of speech acceleration.
Queue saturation cannot block ASR or drop source ownership.
Every queue, decode, and finish timeout produces a typed fallback, cleans its sequence state, and resolves exactly once.
Fatal failure and recovery paths leave no stuck overlay, waiter, session, or stale paste.

Show cleaning only for real backlog, finalizing only for unresolved stop-tail work, and degraded only for mixed or raw fallback. Keep active tied to installed plus ready and make no layout redesign or history migration.
building_blocks: Existing useCleanupModel, RecordingOverlay, AIModelsStatusCard, StatusPing, and Badge

files.what: Emit cleaning and finalizing only from real scheduler backlog and unresolved-tail state.
Render existing restrained working UI for cleaning and finalizing without changing the layout.
Listen for CleanupRunStatusEvent and refresh real status after applied, degraded, failed, or cancelled runs.
Map backend ready and last-run summary to active, loading, degraded, and unavailable ping/badge states.
Add concise cleaning, finalizing, and degraded labels through the existing locale workflow.

subtasks.description: Extend StreamWorkKind exhaustively with cleaning and finalizing and emit transitions only from backend queue/tail state.
Subscribe useCleanupModel to events.cleanupRunStatusEvent, update or refresh last_run, and remove no existing install/ready/failure listener.
Map installed plus ready to Active; PartiallyApplied or raw fallback to Degraded; installation/loading to orange; engine error/unavailable to rose.
Reuse the overlay's existing working presentation for Cleaning and Finalizing and hide it immediately when cleanup has already caught up.
Add all locale keys and run the translation checker; do not persist per-entry cleanup provenance or change the Journal layout.

tests.description: Type-check exhaustive rendering of every lifecycle and final-source combination.
Tauri smoke short, long, degraded, unavailable, cancelled, and already-caught-up flows and assert no stuck or false state.
Run the translation checker with every new key present.

acceptance_criteria: The backend, not static copy, is the only source of cleanup state.
Cleaning and Finalizing appear only while corresponding work exists.
A rejected or mixed-fallback run cannot appear as a successful cleanup run.
The Journal card stays visually unchanged apart from truthful text and state, and every locale is complete.

tasks.title: Run the full production-path quality, latency, and soak gate
tasks.description: Create runnable deterministic and ignored real-model replay modules, then measure the exact shipped path on short, 2-to-5-minute, 10-minute, 20-minute, and 30-minute traces. Verify fidelity invariants, no common-word ALL-CAPS regressions, stop-to-paste distributions, backlog, ASR coexistence, memory, cancellation, failure recovery, and frontend state. Record an explicit go or no-go.
building_blocks: Quality corpus and blind A/B rubric

files.what: Expand committed fixtures for every quality and collision invariant.
Store sanitized SessionTrace records with session ID, language, revisions, committed/tentative snapshots, final text, source hash, and expected invariants.
Run deterministic production-module trace replay and ignored real-model M1 cases under crate-private access.
Record commands, hashes, quality decisions, p50/p95/p99 latency, backlog, memory, failures, and final go/no-go.

subtasks.description: Define and parse SessionTrace JSONL and cover conversation, profanity, repetitions, corrections, values, negations, code, paths, three-item lists, non-lists, filler-only, punctuation-free commits, divergence, overload, non-English, and cancellation.

Require 100 percent preservation of explicit numbers, currency, percentages, paths, extensions, identifiers, negations, source ordering, no invented syntax/headings, and zero unexplained common-word ALL-CAPS.
Run blind A/B against the f9e1c16 output baseline and require at least 80 percent preference with no hard-invariant failure.
Require stop-to-paste at most 1.5 s p50 and 3 s p95 for 10-minute streams, and 2.5 s p50 and 5 s p95 for 30-minute streams when cleanup kept pace; report overload separately.
Run 30-minute concurrent Parakeet/S1 soak with no crash, deadlock, swap, stale result, lost text, or ASR RTF regression above 10 percent.

Run deterministic replay with cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib local_cleanup::replay_tests and real-model replay with cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib local_cleanup::replay_tests::real_model -- --ignored --nocapture.
Run cargo fmt check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --all-targets, bun run build, bun run lint, bun run format:check, bun run check:translations, and targeted Tauri UI smoke.
Write verification-report.md and declare go only if every new gate passes; identify exact pre-existing failures and leave no-go for any new or unrun gate.

tests.description: Run deterministic fixtures through the same session, scheduler, validator, and assembler modules used in production.
Run real Metal 2-, 5-, 10-, 20-, and 30-minute traces and failure injection on the target M1.
Run the complete Rust, TypeScript, lint, format, translation, and Tauri smoke command set.

acceptance_criteria: Every English run proves S1 applied or reports a typed degraded/fallback reason; no silent fallback remains.
Zero fixture loses or reorders source, changes protected values or negations, invents syntax, loops, or produces unexplained common-word ALL-CAPS.
Long-stream latency, backlog, ASR coexistence, memory, cancellation, timeout, and soak gates pass on the M1 8 GB machine.
verification-report.md distinguishes prompt evaluation, generation, queue wait, total time, and stop-tail latency and labels every unrun check honestly.
The release remains no-go for any new failure or missing target-hardware evidence.
